answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable copper stake before it can transact, like a terrace that only holds weight once its foundation is paid for. Creating one identity is cheap, but spinning up thousands means locking thousands of stakes, so a sybil farm cost scales linearly while its reward does not. Add a velvet-smooth reputation decay: identities that stay silent earn nothing, so idle sockpuppets bleed value instead of accumulating influence.
